Name: Simple Mine Loot
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[size=4][center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]⛏ Simple Mine Loot[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[size=5][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/size]
This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.

Mod Requested By: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url][/b]

Find extra supplies and valuable chest rewards in the Mines and Skull Cavern. Choose the loot, container mix and floor spawn chance.

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]✨ Features[/color][/b][/size]

• [b]Extra loot containers:[/b] find bonus chests, crates and barrels in single-player, or shared loot chests in multiplayer, on ordinary Mines and Skull Cavern floors. Toggle each type and location separately.
• [b]Adjust the floor chance:[/b] choose 0–100%, with 100% as the default. One roll is made per generated floor; clear space is still required.
• [b]Separate loot pools:[/b] crates and barrels share a supplies profile, favouring resources and monster drops. Chests use a separate profile favouring gems, geodes and processed materials, without ordinary wood, stone, coal, basic ore, quartz or earth crystals.
• [b]Choose the container mix:[/b] adjust crate, barrel and chest weights independently. Defaults are 45 / 45 / 10, with at most one bonus chest reward per floor. Weights are relative selection chances, not floor percentages. Set a weight to zero to exclude that type.
• [b]Choose how much loot:[/b] adjust the total container count and each pool’s loot entries, quantities, categories and rare rewards independently.
• [b]Depth-based rewards:[/b] deeper floors unlock stronger rewards when progression is enabled. Choose loot categories and whether rare rewards are allowed.
• [b]Collect naturally:[/b] use a receiving menu for single-player chests, break single-player crates and barrels, or open multiplayer chests to release shared ground loot.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1792257896-1182844786.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]🤝 Multiplayer[/color][/b][/size]

• [b]Host installs, everyone can collect:[/b] only the host needs the mod. Installing it only on a farmhand does not add bonus loot.
• [b]Shared rewards:[/b] the host chooses spawning and loot settings. The supplies and valuable-chest profiles remain separate, but each container’s contents are shared between players rather than duplicated per person.
• [b]Shared chests:[/b] enabled crate, barrel and chest reward types all appear as native synchronized chests in multiplayer. Each retains its selected supplies or valuable-chest pool. The chest reward limit counts only the valuable reward type. Turning all types off disables spawning. Single-player keeps all three appearances.
• [b]Open and collect:[/b] use the normal action button. Multiplayer chests open once and drop their contents on the ground using native treasure-chest behaviour. Make inventory space or let another player collect them before the floor resets.
• [b]Farmhand mine runs:[/b] newly generated floors can receive loot when a farmhand enters while the host stays elsewhere.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1793045848-691886406.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#8FDAC0]🔎 Placement & Diagnostics[/color][/b][/size]

• [b]Safe placement:[/b] containers use available safe positions. Blocked floors can still limit how many fit.
• [b]Know why a floor was skipped:[/b] use [b]sml_status[/b] on the host in the SMAPI console to see the last placement result, including disabled settings, protected floors, chance rolls, missing loot or insufficient space. It does not generate or refill loot.
• [b]Check both loot pools:[/b] GMCM shows separate supplies and chest entry counts at your current mine depth. The host’s [b]sml_status[/b] diagnostic also identifies the chest reward limit. Repeated rewards are possible; diagnostics do not refill a floor.

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]⚙ Loot Settings[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Floor chance:[/b] 100% default · adjustable 0–100%
[b]Containers per successful floor:[/b] 1–2 default · adjustable 1–10
[b]Loot entries per container, separately for each pool:[/b] 1–3 default · adjustable 1–20
[b]Quantity per entry, separately for each pool:[/b] 1–5 default · adjustable 1–50
Equipment stays at one per entry. Repeated item selections are possible.

[b]Container weights:[/b] crates 45 · barrels 45 · chests 10; each adjustable 0–100.
[b]Valuable chest reward limit:[/b] 1 per floor by default · adjustable 1–10. This is a maximum, not a guaranteed chest.

[b]Fresh-config supplies defaults:[/b] resources & ore and monster loot enabled.
[b]Fresh-config chest defaults:[/b] resources, minerals and geodes enabled; chest resources use processed materials instead of common filler.
[b]Off in both profiles by default:[/b] food, artifacts, equipment and rare loot. Artifacts and equipment also require Rare loot. Disabling progression removes depth limits while category and rare-loot switches still apply. Empty pools are skipped.

Existing count/quantity preferences and disabled categories seed the new profiles when updating. Once set, the profiles keep their independent settings.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1793045850-662192424.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]🎒 How to Use[/color][/b][/size]

Enter a [b]newly generated ordinary floor[/b]. In single-player, open a bonus chest to collect items without depositing, or break crates and barrels. In multiplayer, open a shared chest with the normal action button; its contents drop onto the ground for players to collect. Re-entering the same floor does not refill it.

Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the settings. Without GMCM, close the game and edit config.json after first launch. Changes apply to future floor attempts. Run [b]sml_status[/b] on the host while on a mine floor to inspect its last attempt. Placed counts describe that original attempt, including containers already collected or removed before saving.



[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 ℹ Before You Play[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Collect loot before leaving.[/b] Bonus containers are temporary: unloaded or reset floors lose them, and tracked bonus containers are removed before saving. They are not permanent storage.

[b]PC single-player and host-only multiplayer.[/b] Split-screen is inactive. Reward/treasure rooms, infested and dinosaur floors, Quarry Mine, custom side branches and Volcano Dungeon are excluded. Existing generated floors are not filled retroactively.

Loot comes from curated vanilla item pools; arbitrary modded-item pools are not included.

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]📦 Requirements & Installation[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/url][/b]. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
Extract [b]SimpleMineLoot[/b] into [b]Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI. In multiplayer, install it on the host only; farmhands do not need the mod or SMAPI. Preserve your config.json when updating.

[size=5][b][color=#C8B0F4]🌍 Languages & Previews[/color][/b][/size]

English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian. Translations are AI-assisted.

Preview images are isolated native renders, not live gameplay. The mine scene uses a stock layout with controlled container positions. Game artwork is loaded from your installed game. Generative AI was used for code, settings text, translations and this page.

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]

Please post reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include your mod/game/SMAPI versions and platform, expected versus actual behaviour, steps to reproduce and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. A screenshot or short video can help. For suggestions, explain what you would change and how it would help.
